EXAMPLE RECORD (invented "Acme Orders" domain).

## Question

Which PostgreSQL and C# types hold money amounts, given BC-005 (two fraction digits plus a currency code)?

## Answer

`numeric(18,2)` in PostgreSQL and `decimal` in C#; never `double`, never PostgreSQL `money`. The currency is a separate `char(3)` column. Recorded as OD-001.
